name: LANE_REGISTRY_ACTIVE_DAYS_LQ271_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: LANE_REGISTRY_ACTIVE_DAYS_LQ271_20261107 — LQ-20261107-271, the weekend half of SILENT.
Measured 2026-11-07 (Saturday): lane_registry graded 19 weekday/Sunday-only lanes SILENT because
config/lane_registry.json declared no active_days for them, and _within_declared_days treats an
absent declaration as 'in window every day'. Their cron expressions already stated the days
This gate pins the declaration on exactly those nineteen rows, derived from each row's own cron day
field, and pins the blast radius: on a Saturday those nineteen move SILENT -> EXPECTED_SILENT and no
other row changes verdict; on a Monday the declaration changes nothing.
Hermetic: observe_signal is stubbed and the scheduler inventory is synthetic; no live artifact,
